title: Survive an arena challenge or equivalent
description:
Explore a style that suits you: shield and steel, a mobile bow, or spells with reliable recovery. Sky and Ice Arenas are optional places, not assumed boss kills.

Survive an arena challenge or equivalent.

This entry records that you read the advice. It does not detect a fight, gear quality, a completed expedition or a claimed reward.
